license: Mixed library: mostly CC0; CC-BY attribution, Pixabay Content License audio, and unverified user-provided assets are tracked separately. See CREDITS.md and assets/game/licenses/.

decisions.KayKit Platformer: Selected high-value runner/platformer pieces; converted from external GLTF/BIN/PNG into standalone GLB files.
decisions.Animal Pack Remastered: Normal Round and Square PNG variants retained; outline/no-detail duplicates removed.
decisions.Fish Pack: Default individual PNG assets retained; Double/vector/spritesheet duplicates removed.
decisions.Boardgame Pack: Individual PNG cards/chips/dice/pieces plus OGG board-game sounds retained.
decisions.Puzzle Pack II: Back tiles, balls, coins, paddles, pipes and particles retained; large repeated colored tile grids removed.
decisions.Sports Pack: Equipment, elements, special objects and character color sets retained.
decisions.Planets: 10 finished planet PNGs retained; compositing source parts removed.

kenney-platformer-art-deluxe.runtime_policy: Imported individual PNG assets; preview/vector/SWF/full redundant sheets omitted. Extended-enemies content imported here once.

kenney-platformer-art-extended-enemies.runtime_policy: No duplicate runtime copy. Verified as byte-identical subset of Platformer Art Deluxe extended-enemies section; license/provenance retained only.

kenney-flag-pack.runtime_policy: Kept Large (2×) 128px PNG flags only; Default and SVG duplicate representations omitted.

kenney-pixel-vehicle-pack.runtime_policy: Individual Cars/Characters/Props retained; one complete spritesheet+XML pair retained as optional atlas.

kenney-rpg-urban-pack.runtime_policy: All 16px individual tiles retained; packed tilemap + TXT metadata retained as a compound atlas.

kenney-pirate-pack.runtime_policy: Retina PNG set retained; Default/vector/SWF duplicates omitted. High-res ship atlas+XML and tile sheet+TXT retained as compound groups.

kenney-tower-defense-top-down.runtime_policy: Retina 128px PNG set retained; Default/vector/SWF duplicates omitted. High-res tilesheet retained.

kenney-letter-tiles.runtime_policy: All individual letter tiles retained; each color spritesheet kept only with its matching XML frame map.

kenney-tower-defense-isometric.runtime_policy: All individual PNG assets retained; spritesheets retained only with their matching XML frame maps.

v3_safety_rules: Existing v2 paths are unchanged for backwards compatibility.
New filenames/directories are normalized to URL-safe lowercase kebab-case.
Each imported file is traceable through assets/game/import-map.json.
Spritesheet/atlas metadata dependencies are declared in assets/game/compound-assets.json and must move together.
Platformer extended-enemies standalone ZIP was not duplicated because its runtime content is already byte-identical inside Platformer Art Deluxe.
Default/Retina or Default/Large duplicate representations were reduced to one selected runtime resolution where appropriate.
